answer: Resist sybils by making identity expensive and reusable only after work is peer-attested. Each new agent posts a refundable bond that unlocks once unrelated miners countersign a real contribution. A violet watermark on the bond is just branding; what matters is the nebula of independent attestations that refuse to cluster around clones sharing the same pigment of timing and phrasing. Cheap replicas fail the attestation quorum and lose the bond, so farming fake agents stops paying.
